## Soft Metadata

> [!WARNING]
> **Tier 2 (community estimate)** — Soft Metadata below adapted from Guilford publisher pages and domain knowledge of social-clinical psychology interface editorial culture. Submission practitioners are invited to upgrade individual claims to Tier 1 via `/ja-validate`. See [SEED_DATA_QUALITY.md](../../../../SEED_DATA_QUALITY.md) for the Skeleton → Tier 2 → Tier 1 lifecycle.

> **The core value of this entry.** OpenAlex cannot fill any of these — they require lived experience and community knowledge. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../../../CONTRIBUTING.md) for guidance.

### Epistemological & Political Leanings

| Dimension | Assessment |
|-----------|------------|
| **Cross-cultural friendliness** | High |
| **Non-Western epistemology openness** | Medium |
| **Diversity topic receptiveness** | High — minority stress, identity-based mental health |
| **Dominant theoretical tradition** | Social-clinical interface — minority stress (Meyer), attachment × psychopathology, self / identity × mental health, stigma, social rejection × wellbeing |

### Framing Requirements

- **Mandatory framing?** Yes (strong)
- **If yes, what kind?** Manuscripts must demonstrate **social-clinical psychology integration** — social processes influencing mental health, or clinical phenomena interpreted through social-psychological lens.
- **Consequences of ignoring it**: Pure social psychology redirected to JPSP/PSPB; pure clinical psychology redirected to JCCP.

## Strategic Notes

### Hard Blockers

- Pure social psychology without clinical implications
- Pure clinical psychology without social processes
- AI use without disclosure per Guilford policy

### Soft Tax

Low for social-clinical tradition authors. Guilford venue tends to value theoretical depth.

### Best Suited For

- Minority stress research
- Attachment × psychopathology empirical work
- Stigma research
- Identity-based mental health studies
- Social rejection and wellbeing
- LGBTQ mental health

### Not Recommended For

- Pure social psychology (consider JPSP, PSPB)
- Pure clinical without social processes (consider JCCP)
- Pure qualitative work

### Rejection Fallback Chain

| Rank | Journal | Why this fallback works |
|------|---------|------------------------|
| 1 | [Journal of Consulting and Clinical Psychology](./journal-of-consulting-and-clinical-psychology.md) | If treatment-focused; APA flagship |
| 2 | [Self and Identity](./self-and-identity.md) | If identity-process focus |
| 3 | [Journal of Applied Social Psychology](./journal-of-applied-social-psychology.md) | If applied social angle |

**Reverse direction** *(optional)*: If your paper was rejected from JCCP as "more social than clinical," JSCP is the Guilford home for social-clinical interface.
